tool_args.rationale: The branch probe shows that the sink gradient strongly suppresses transfer, but every observation is still an endpoint at H=0.6. The trajectory batch is the remaining targeted measurement for distinguishing a static flux law from a transient two-layer transfer law before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static sink-inhibited saturation law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A simple rational fit has a training RMSE of about 0.032, but it drives the baseline resistance toward zero. More flexible forms fit better without resolving whether that improvement comes from the sink-response law or from unobserved transient dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a coupled two-layer transfer model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All seven measurements share the same initial state and readout horizon, so they do not directly constrain the time evolution of the two layers.
Already acquired. It established strong sink inhibition but added no measurements at other horizons.
